name: New Mexico

fees.note: Truckers Guide: single trip oversize permit $25; single trip overweight permit $25 (one permit when both - verify). Valid 5 days (18.19.8.50).
Over 86,400 lb: $0.025 per ton-mile on the weight above 86,400 lb (statute rounds per 2,000 lb or major fraction). Loads > 170,000 lb also need a route engineering analysis; NMDOT may bill its cost.

Police escort for loads 20' or wider. NMSA 66-7-413(B) (2003 text) set $300 per day for state/local police escort on moves of 20'+ width over 5+ miles - current amount not confirmed from an official source.

Over 17'11" wide, on two-lane and other roads
Over 110'1" long, on interstates and freeways
Over 110'1" long, on two-lane and other roads

police.text: 1 police escort. 20' or wider: police escort at NMDOT discretion (18.19.8.84); MVD FAQ says required. Flagmen also required at 20'+.

restrictions.text: Daylight only (30 min before sunrise to 30 min after sunset), any day of the week, unless the permit allows continuous movement - only available up to 10' wide, 14'6" high, 120' long, 140,000 lb.

No movement on holidays (New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas; 12:01 am-11:59 pm) or in inclement weather (snow, ice, fog, rain, dust, visibility < 1000 ft; winds 25+ mph for oversize).
Weekday curfews 7-9 am and 4-6 pm: Santa Fe and Las Cruces city limits, I-25 Santa Fe-Los Lunas, US-285 Santa Fe-Espanola, I-10 MM 139-145, I-25 MM 0-9; Albuquerque and Rio Rancho 7-9 am and 4-7 pm.
OS/OW permits must be bought online (NM-OPS) and in hand before entering New Mexico.

notes: Escorts may also be required below 14' wide on routes shown on the NMDOT Escort Map (Group A highways: 13'6" and over; Group B: 12' and over on pickup/delivery; some cities off-interstate) - not modeled.
An escort or extra person may be required above 16' high to verify clearances; NMDOT may require escorts for projecting loads (both discretionary, not modeled).
Height 14'-15'6": applicant must check the route for clearances; 15'6"+: written route survey (valid 14 days); 18'+: written utility certification.
The MVD escort FAQ dates from 2013 (it still lists 90' for length; the 2022 rule uses 110'1"). The 18' two-lane front+rear rule comes only from that FAQ - verify.
Gross legal weight 86,400 lb applies on federally designated routes subject to the NM axle/tire table (600 lb per inch of tire width).
